name: Indexed Interaction Paths
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = data structure, `(O)` = operation. Named operations/data map to the source shown below them.

                               REPRESENTATION INTERACTION

USER CHOICES
|
+-- (O) DiagramSet selection
|      `src/components/DiagramSetTreePanel.tsx:DiagramSetTreePanel`; `src/App.tsx:selectDiagramFromSet`
|      Current/starred set or Diagram activation selects the active Diagram Representation.
|
+-- (O) Candidate batches and starred views
|      `src/components/DiagramLineagePanel.tsx:renderCandidateBatch/renderDiagram`
|      Select a ranked candidate or the featured view identified by `DiagramSetRecord.featuredViewIds`.
|
+-- (O) DiagramComponent selection
|      `src/components/DiagramLineagePanel.tsx:ComponentLineageSection`; `src/App.tsx:selectComponent`
|      Open a captured/generated component on the component Representation surface.
|
`-- [D] Representation layers and feedback
       `src/components/RepresentationLayersPanel.tsx:RepresentationLayersPanel`
       `src/representationGraph.ts:orderRepresentationLayers`
       Choose a revision-bound layer by increasing information rank; target feedback at its incoming transition.

       independent choices establish one active context
       |
       v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [D] Active Representation context                                                                   |
|     selected Diagram/component + view kind + ASCII revision + current layer                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       |
       | active revision, mapping and mode
       v
(O) DiagramView interaction surface
    `src/components/DiagramView.tsx:DiagramView`
    validate `activeMap` against the active ASCII revision; exclude edit-unsafe/stale mappings
    build the chosen tree/diagram index and derive mapped-reference state
    choose navigate, rectangle-reference, component-capture or ASCII-edit grid mode
       |
       v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [D] Stable RepresentationIndex                                                                     |
|      `src/representationIndex.ts:buildRepresentationIndex`                                          |
|                                                                                                      |
|      revision-scoped tree nodes and visual elements                                                  |
|      stable structural or persisted-mapping IDs + `EvidenceElementLink`                              |
|      bidirectional `spatialEvidenceResolver`: visual element <-> Evidence                             |
|      stale revisions/maps rejected before hover, reveal, selection, collapse, highlight or buffering|
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       |
       | indexed rendered lines + mappings + interaction mode
       v
(O) AsciiSelectionGrid element commands
    `src/components/AsciiSelectionGrid.tsx:AsciiSelectionGrid`
    hover mapped text -> Evidence identity and exact source location; activate -> `onReveal`
    tree gutter -> collapse indexed subtree; mapped gutter -> toggle stable-element highlight
    pointer drag -> normalized rectangle; DiagramView routes release according to the active mode
       |
       +---- mapped activation / hover
       |      (O) Representation -> Evidence -> Corpus
       |          `src/App.tsx:revealCodeEntity`; `src/components/CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx:CodeEntitiesPanel`
       |          [Representation] stable mapped element
       |                | Evidence entity + `sourceRangeIndex`
       |                v
       |          [Evidence] selected CodeEntity and exact range
       |                | load authoritative source snippet
       |                v
       |          [Corpus] `SourceCodeView` or `TerminalMarkdownView`
       |          Grounding invariant: Representation -> Evidence -> Corpus; never bypass Evidence.
       |
       |      (O) Reversible pane movement
       |          `src/panes/navigation.ts:PaneNavigationApi`
       |          forward: activate/focus pane and tab, then deliver destination data after render
       |          history: bounded and de-duplicated across Representation, Evidence and Corpus
       |          reverse: replay a prior jump to restore context, or clear the history
       |
       +---- drag rectangle / reference mode
       |      (O) Rectangle selection to buffer
       |          `src/components/DiagramView.tsx:completeSelection`; `src/diagramSelection.ts:mappingsForSelection`
       |          normalize bounds -> intersect current mappings -> mapped Evidence identities
       |          preview the resulting buffered mappings on the active Representation
       |
       |      [D] Scoped reference buffer
       |          `src/refBuffer.ts:referencesFromMappings/reduceRefBuffer`
       |          mappings -> scoped references; add/remove/toggle without losing source identity
       |                |
       |                v
       |      (O) Buffered call-graph focus
       |          `src/ref-buffer/RefBufferTray.tsx:displayCallGraph`; `src/callGraphFocus.ts:createCallGraphFocusRequest`
       |          keep resolved references mapped on the active source Diagram
       |          validate/deduplicate CodeEntity IDs -> `src/App.tsx:openCallGraphFocus`
       |
       +---- capture rectangle / edit controls
       |      (O) Component capture and edit mode
       |          `src/components/DiagramView.tsx:saveCapture/editMode`; `src/App.tsx:capture/startEdit/leaveEdit`
       |          capture: released bounds -> component capture -> completion feedback
       |          captured DiagramComponent --`selectComponent`--> component choice above
       |          edit: disable incompatible commands and replace the grid with the ASCII editor
       |          start/exit explicitly; stale mappings remain excluded from the editable Representation
       |
       `---- chosen layer / transition feedback
              active revision/layer -> DiagramView; feedback -> `RepresentationLayersPanel`
              [D] `RepresentationFeedbackTarget` identifies the evidence-bearing incoming transition
              revision binding keeps feedback aligned with the RepresentationIndex context
